achievements.name: First Dive
achievements.detail: Return from a Blue Hole dive with fish for the restaurant.

achievements.name: Repairs Paid
achievements.detail: Earn enough gold at Bancho Sushi to pay for the earthquake repairs.

achievements.name: Dinner Service
achievements.detail: Work a full evening of pouring tea, serving plates, restocking wasabi, and clearing tables.

achievements.name: Cooksta Rank
achievements.detail: Raise Bancho Sushi by one rank on Cooksta.

achievements.name: New Hire
achievements.detail: Hire a cook or a server and put them on a night's schedule.

achievements.name: New Recipe
achievements.detail: Spend Artisan's Flame to research a dish and add it to the menu.

achievements.name: Enhanced Dish
achievements.detail: Enhance a recipe so the dish rates higher than the version you first learned.

achievements.name: Deeper Dive
achievements.detail: Upgrade your diving gear and explore past the shallows of the Blue Hole.

achievements.name: Fish Farm
achievements.detail: Catch a fish whose roe is sent to one of Otto's farm pools.

achievements.name: VIP Night
achievements.detail: Serve a VIP guest the dish they came to Bancho Sushi to eat.

achievements.name: Final Chapter
achievements.detail: Finish the last chapter of the main story.
